sections.changelog: v1.2.106: Elements floating panel handles now render even before a Bricks element is selected. Structure shortcut rail drag cleanup now clears transforms and stays below MV Studio overlays. Bricks media selection now remembers the originating control and can insert the selected media URL, with a safe copy fallback. Media conversion now uses converting/converted toasts without reloading the whole Studio. Content Studio section switching clears stale rows immediately, Edit in Studio opens the inline editor more reliably, CSS Recipes now has a dedicated Studio panel, and the panel behavior setting is labelled for single/multiple panel use.
